The '''''Suveron''''' was a [[B-12 Bacta Transport]].<ref name="SWG:TGTLM" /> Sometime before [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the ship exploded in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] due to critical reactor failure. The destruction of the ''Suveron'' released a half million tons of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in space. Although it was not suitable for medicinal use anymore, the bacta survived the vacuum of space and formed a large pocket of space gas later known as the [[Linear Miasma]]. This unique phenomenon made the Linear Miasma popular among research communities.<ref name="SWG:TGTLM" />
